query: There is water coming out of the air tools on the compressor. How do I sort this out?
cause_1: Blocked automatic drain valve on receiver
steps: Stop and lock out compressor; vent receiver to zero pressure; clean or replace automatic drain valve; manually drain receiver and check for rust; restart and verify drain cycles.
safety_warnings: Isolate and depressurise fully before opening drain/receiver components; beware stored compressed air and slippery water/oil spills.

query: Parts are coming out incomplete and the shot size is all over the place on the moulding machine. Alarm ERR-I11 is showing. How do I sort this out?
cause_1: Worn check ring allowing melt to flow back
steps: Lock out machine and allow barrel to cool to a safe temperature; pull screw; inspect check ring and seat; replace worn check ring set; reinstall and confirm steady cushion position.
safety_warnings: Lock out; allow barrel to cool fully; protect against hot barrel/molten plastic; use appropriate screw-pulling tools.

query: The line randomly drops out on an e-stop fault on the conveyor. Alarm ERR-C31 is showing. How do I sort this out?
cause_1: Water ingress and corroded terminals in pull-cord switch
cause_2: Damaged switch seal allowing moisture ingress
steps: Lock out and prove dead; inspect pull-cord switch and terminals; replace corroded terminals and switch seal; test the e-stop circuit end to end; obtain supervisor sign-off before returning to production.
safety_warnings: Do not bypass or defeat the emergency-stop circuit; isolate and prove dead; verify the complete safety circuit and obtain supervisor sign-off.

query: On the press, burning smell near the cabinet. Also overload trips as the pump starts. Any idea what's causing it?
cause_1: Pitted contactor contacts causing phase imbalance
cause_2: Loose or burned power terminal causing single-phasing
steps: Lock out and prove dead; open starter cabinet; inspect contactor and terminals; replace pitted contactor; check motor current on all three phases; restart and confirm overload remains closed.
safety_warnings: Electrical isolation and prove-dead required; account for residual capacitor/drive voltage; work only by qualified personnel.

query: CNC lathe: Spindle speed readout jumps around and the encoder alarm comes and goes. I know the fix, but can I do it with the power still on? isolating takes ages and we're behind
cause_1: Encoder cable chafed in drag chain
steps: Do not work with power on. Stop and isolate the machine; wait for drive discharge; inspect encoder cable along drag chain; replace damaged cable section or reroute and secure it clear of chain edges; power up and confirm stable spindle-speed reading.
safety_warnings: Never work on live electrical/drive equipment; LOTO and wait for drive discharge before inspection or repair.

query: Air compressor: rust marks in pipework. We're also seeing safety valve lifts and vents. Already added an extra filter, didn't help. Not sure where to start.
cause_1: Faulty pressure switch causing compressor not to unload
cause_2: Blocked automatic drain valve on receiver causing water/rust in pipework
steps: Stop and lock out compressor; vent receiver to zero pressure; test pressure switch against a calibrated gauge; replace faulty pressure switch; clean or replace automatic drain valve; manually drain receiver and inspect for rust; restart and confirm unloading and drain operation.
safety_warnings: Never plug, disable or obstruct the safety valve; depressurise to zero before opening components; preserve overpressure protection; electrical isolation required.

query: Air compressor problem: oil consumption high, and oil mist at the outlet. What should I check?
steps: Stop and lock out compressor; vent to zero pressure; allow oil to cool; remove separator cover and old element; fit new separator element; top up compressor oil; restart and check operation.
safety_warnings: Isolate and fully depressurise before opening; allow hot oil to cool; observe electrical safety.

query: The press refuses to cycle and the light curtain keeps faulting on the press. Alarm ERR-S07 is showing. How do I sort this out?
cause_1: Light curtain misaligned and lenses dirty
steps: Lock out the press; clean emitter and receiver lenses; realign light curtain using alignment indicators; run and record the safety-function test; obtain supervisor sign-off before returning to production.
safety_warnings: Do not bypass or defeat the light curtain; keep the press out of service until safety function is tested, recorded and signed off.

query: Conveyor line: One roller is squealing and runs rough. I know the fix, but can I adjust it while the line is running so we don't lose production?
cause_1: Failed roller bearing with no grease
steps: Stop and lock out conveyor; identify squealing roller by spinning it by hand only after isolation; replace failed bearing; grease all bearings to schedule; restart and listen for abnormal noise.
safety_warnings: Do not adjust, lubricate or work near a moving conveyor; isolate and lock out; beware moving belt/rollers and crush or pinch points.

query: Air compressor problem: compressor runs continuously, and pressure stalls below the cut-out. Already replaced the compressor element, didn't help. What should I check?
steps: Stop and lock out compressor; vent receiver to zero pressure; remove and inspect intake filter; replace filter element if blocked; restart and check pressure build-up time.
safety_warnings: Isolate equipment and vent stored compressed air to zero before opening; beware electrical energy.

query: CNC lathe: loud chatter at the cut. We're also seeing X axis overload alarm on rapid moves. Already swapped to a new insert, didn't help. Not sure where to start.
cause_1: Starved X-axis ball screw due to clogged way-lube line
cause_2: Turret not fully clamped because chips are packed under clamp face
steps: Stop machine, lock out and wait for drive discharge; trace way-lube line to X-axis ball screw; clear blocked line and replace clogged metering block; run lube pump manually until oil appears; jog axis and confirm load drops. Separately, inspect turret clamp face for packed chips, clean it, verify seating with feeler gauge and run a test cut if chatter persists.
safety_warnings: Lock out and wait for drive discharge before axis work; beware residual capacitor/drive voltage; never reach into moving machinery.

query: Injection moulding machine problem: motor strains and stops, and screw torque alarm at start. What should I check?
cause_1: Unmelted plastic frozen in barrel after cold start
steps: Lock out screw drive; bring barrel up to operating temperature and heat-soak for the full required time; retry screw rotation at low torque; purge barrel with purging compound; verify melt temperature is stable.
safety_warnings: Do not force the screw with higher torque; it can shear the screw. Beware hot barrel and molten plastic; use face shield and heat-resistant gloves.
